But regardless of who they were, at the very least, they wanted to marry someone who wasn’t s*upid, right?
Unfortunately, Zhao Junyi ended up marrying a fool.
The other toads nearly died laughing.
The fallen noble ladies who had previously looked down on all of them had, without exception, taken a liking to Zhao Junyi. Sure, everyone at the frontier was poor, but who could blame them when Zhao Junyi was blessed with both excellent looks and impeccable character?
Now that Zhao Junyi had married a fool, the other soldiers naturally couldn’t wait to make fun of him.
Zhao Junyi planned to raise his foolish Fulang like a five-year-old younger brother, all the way until the day he died.
But no one could have expected that one day, his foolish Fulang would suddenly become completely normal.
Not only was he no longer s*upid, he was exceptionally clever and lively.
He knew how to make money and support the household.
He also knew how to care for him.
Every time Zhao Junyi returned to the military camp, he would be carrying large bags filled with comfortable clothes and exquisite food.
His fellow soldiers would look down at their own hands, filled with coarse vegetables and terrible rations, then look at Zhao Junyi’s belongings.
And collectively lose their minds.
No, seriously.
Why does he get to have all that?!
